description: Data payload shape of '<domain>.status' commands, i.e. the 'data' member of the envelope (docs/GUI-ARCHITECTURE-PROPOSAL.md section 2.2/2.3). Cross-file $ref is not allowed in this contract, so '$defs.element', '$defs.freshness' and '$defs.action' below are verbatim inline copies of element.schema.json; tests/test_engine_contract.py enforces that the copies stay equal. See contract/README.md.

domain.description: Domain that produced this status, e.g. 'mcp' or 'skills'.

elements.description: One entry per managed element of the domain.

element.description: Engine Contract v1 element model (docs/GUI-ARCHITECTURE-PROPOSAL.md section 3). Every managed object (agent, MCP server, skill, rules target, hooks, tool, alias) is exposed as one element carrying two independent state axes: the convergence axis 'state' (local vs desired, section 3.1) and the upstream axis 'freshness' (local vs upstream latest, section 3.3).

spec.description: Definition layer: the desired shape sourced from config/*.json. Free-form per domain.

policy.description: Merged three-layer policy result for this element (manager.json + manager.synced.json + manager.local.json, proposal section 7.2). Free-form per domain.

observed.description: Physical state probed at runtime. Free-form per domain.

actions.description: Actions the engine offers for this element; the GUI renders buttons from this list only.

freshness.description: Upstream axis block (proposal section 3.3). Value fields are required but nullable: 'not-applicable' and never-probed 'unknown' elements carry nulls. 'status' commands read only the probe cache and never hit the network; 'system.refresh-upstream' is the only writer of fresh values.

state.description: Upstream axis state. 'unknown' is a first-class state: probes that failed or never ran; convergence conservatively skips downloads in this state.

upstream.description: Upstream latest version/commit as of 'checked_at', or null.

checked_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the last upstream probe, or null when never probed.

probe.description: Probe mechanism that produced the upstream value, e.g. 'npm-view' or 'git-ls-remote', or null.

cache_age_sec.description: Age of the cached probe result in seconds at render time, or null when there is no cached result.

action.description: One element-level action offered by the engine.

risk.description: Risk level (proposal section 2.4): read < write-local < exec-local < network < install-remove.

needs_lock.description: true when executing this action requires the engine lock.

offline_ok.description: true when this action is allowed in offline mode.
